enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Parrying +2: +2 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +2 Insight bonus to Saves.
Doublestrike 7%: Passive: 7% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
